sentences.en: The Pope is acknowledging for the first time the persistent problem of nuns being sexually assaulted by priests.
sentences.zh: 教皇首次承认了修女长期遭受神职人员性侵的问题。

sentences.en: Why it took the Catholic Church so long to recognize this group of victiMs. Thursday, February 7th.
sentences.zh: 为什么天主教会花了这么久才意识到这一受害者群体？2月7日，星期四。

sentences.en: So earlier this week, Pope Francis spent three days in the United Arab Emirates.
sentences.zh: 本周早些时候，教皇方济各在阿拉伯联合酋长国进行了为期三天的访问。

sentences.en: A historic trip for a Pope.
sentences.zh: 这对教皇来说是一次历史性的访问。

sentences.en: First time a Pope had ever been in the Arabian Peninsula.
sentences.zh: 这是教皇首次踏足阿拉伯半岛。

sentences.en: Laurie Goodstein has covered the Catholic Church for decades.
sentences.zh: 劳里·古德斯坦报道天主教会已有数十年之久。

sentences.en: He celebrated Mass for more than 100,000 Catholics in that country, most of whom are migrant workers from other Catholic countries.
sentences.zh: 他在该国为超过 10 万名天主教徒主持了弥撒，其中大多数是从其他天主教国家来的外籍劳工。

sentences.en: It was a very emotional event for them to see the Pope.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，能见到教皇是一件非常感人的事情。

sentences.en: The Pope also signed a landmark document on relations between Catholics and MusliMs. And all in all, it was a successful and historic trip.
sentences.zh: 教皇还签署了一份关于天主教徒与穆斯林之间关系的里程碑式文件。总而言之，这是一次成功且具有历史意义的访问。

sentences.en: So on the plane back to Rome, it's traditional for the Pope to take questions from the press corps traveling with him.
sentences.zh: 在返回罗马的飞机上，教皇通常会接受随行媒体的提问。

sentences.en: And it's kind of open mic.
sentences.zh: 这有点像开放麦。

sentences.en: It's whatever the reporters want to ask.
sentences.zh: 记者们想问什么都可以。

sentences.en: And this Pope is very game.
sentences.zh: 而这位教皇非常乐于配合。

sentences.en: He will talk at length with reporters if he is feeling peppy enough.
sentences.zh: 如果他精神状态足够好，他会与记者进行长时间的交谈。

sentences.en: And this time, he got a question that had nothing to do with the trip he had just made.
sentences.zh: 而这一次，他被问到了一个与他刚刚结束的访问毫无关系的问题。

sentences.en: It was from a reporter for the Associated Press, their Vatican correspondent, Nicole Winfield.
sentences.zh: 提问者是美联社的梵蒂冈通讯员妮可·温菲尔德。

sentences.en: She asked him about reports that had been made last week in a Vatican magazine that nuns were being abused by priests and even by bishops.
sentences.zh: 她问及上周梵蒂冈杂志的一篇报道，称修女正受到神职人员甚至主教的虐待。

sentences.en: He said, it's true.
sentences.zh: 他说，这是事实。

sentences.en: In the church, there have been some clerics and in some cultures a little more strongly than others.
sentences.zh: 在教会中，确实存在一些神职人员，在某些文化中这种情况更为严重。

sentences.en: It's not that everyone does this, he said.
sentences.zh: 他说，并不是每个人都这样做。

sentences.en: But there have been priests and bishops who have done this.
sentences.zh: 但确实有神职人员和主教做过这种事。

sentences.en: So here is the Pope saying, on the record, that members of the clergy are sexually abusing nuns.
sentences.zh: 所以，教皇在这里公开承认，神职人员正在性侵修女。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what did you think, as someone who has covered the Catholic Church for more than a quarter of a century, when you heard that?
sentences.zh: 作为一名报道天主教会超过四分之一个世纪的记者，当你听到这些时，你有什么想法？

sentences.en: Well, I was stunned at how open he was responding to this question.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他回应这个问题时表现出的坦诚让我感到震惊。

sentences.en: The issue of nuns being abused, being sexually abused by priests and bishops, is something that has percolated at a very low boil for a very long time.
sentences.zh: 修女遭受神职人员和主教性侵的问题，在很长一段时间里一直处于一种低调发酵的状态。

sentences.en: How long?
sentences.zh: 有多久了？

sentences.en: I first came across this problem reading a report in the National Catholic Reporter in 2001.
sentences.zh: 我第一次接触到这个问题是在 2001 年阅读《国家天主教记者报》的一篇报道时。

sentences.en: They had gotten hold of documents that had been prepared by church officials talking about the problem of sexual abuse of nuns by priests.
sentences.zh: 他们获得了一些由教会官员准备的文件，其中谈到了神职人员性侵修女的问题。

sentences.en: And it got my attention because it was focused on
sentences.zh: 这引起了我的注意，因为它聚焦于

sentences.en: Africa, and in particular, the problem of priests who raped nuns during the AIDS epidemic there, the outbreak of the AIDS epidemic.
sentences.zh: 非洲，特别是当地艾滋病流行期间，神职人员强奸修女的问题。

sentences.en: In fact, there's a report from 1994 by a nun who investigated 23 countries.
sentences.zh: 事实上，有一份 1994 年的报告，由一名调查了 23 个国家的修女撰写。

sentences.en: And she says, for example, a superior of a community of sisters in one country was approached by priests requesting that sisters would be made available to them for sexual favors.
sentences.zh: 她说，例如，某国一个修女团体的负责人曾被神职人员找上门，要求提供修女以满足他们的性需求。

sentences.en: When the superior refused, the priests explained that they would otherwise be obliged to go to the village to find women and might thus get AIDS.
sentences.zh: 当负责人拒绝时，神职人员解释说，否则他们就不得不去村里找女人，从而可能感染艾滋病。

sentences.en: And so what this nun concluded was that sometimes nuns are identified as, quote, safe, unquote, targets for sexual activity.
sentences.zh: 因此，这位修女得出的结论是，有时修女被视为所谓的“安全”性活动目标。

sentences.en: Who would not be carrying the virus.
sentences.zh: 因为她们不会携带病毒。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Safe in quotes, because this was not safe for these women who were who were raped.
sentences.zh: 之所以加引号称其为“安全”，是因为对于这些被强奸的女性来说，这根本不安全。

sentences.en: And they said at the time that it was not just something that went on in Africa, sexual abuse of nuns by priests, but they highlighted the problem on that continent.
sentences.zh: 他们当时表示，神职人员性侵修女不仅发生在非洲，但他们强调了该大陆的问题。

sentences.en: There were no numbers.
sentences.zh: 当时没有任何数据。

sentences.en: There was not an overview of the extent of the problem.
sentences.zh: 没有关于问题严重程度的概览。

sentences.en: But it was the first time I had ever encountered that issue.
sentences.zh: 但那是我第一次遇到这个问题。

sentences.en: And you said it percolated along for a while.
sentences.zh: 你说它发酵了一段时间。

sentences.en: So when was the next time that you heard about it?
sentences.zh: 那么你下一次听到它是什么时候？

sentences.en: Probably the next time was just last year.
sentences.zh: 大概是去年。

sentences.en: There was a report out of India of a nun who accused a bishop of raping her over several years.
sentences.zh: 印度有一篇报道，一名修女指控一位主教多年来一直强奸她。

sentences.en: And she actually went to the police and made a report.
sentences.zh: 她甚至报了警并提交了报告。

sentences.en: And that's very unusual.
sentences.zh: 这非常罕见。

sentences.en: The event ended up splitting her religious order.
sentences.zh: 这件事最终导致她所在的修会分裂。

sentences.en: There were women, other nuns in the religious order who sided with the bishop.
sentences.zh: 修会里有一些修女站在主教那一边。

sentences.en: Then there were some nuns who came to her support and signed a letter in her support.
sentences.zh: 也有一些修女支持她，并签署了一封支持她的信。

sentences.en: And finally, the bishop was arrested.
sentences.zh: 最终，这位主教被捕了。

sentences.en: But that was only after a lot of pressure.
sentences.zh: 但这只是在巨大的压力下才发生的。

sentences.en: And he's now facing trial.
sentences.zh: 他现在正面临审判。

sentences.en: Lori, why do you think that this has remained under the radar for so long?
sentences.zh: 劳里，你认为为什么这个问题会被掩盖这么久？

sentences.en: For so many years, we were consumed with covering another abuse scandal in the church.
sentences.zh: 多年来，我们一直忙于报道教会中的另一桩虐待丑闻。

sentences.en: And that's the abuse of children by priests.
sentences.zh: 那就是神职人员虐待儿童的丑闻。

sentences.en: It was so extensive and so shocking and went on for so long.
sentences.zh: 它范围太广、太令人震惊，而且持续了太久。

sentences.en: The first case emerged in 1985 in Louisiana.
sentences.zh: 第一起案件于 1985 年在路易斯安那州浮出水面。

sentences.en: Then you had the Boston scandal in 2001 that then spread all across the United States.
sentences.zh: 然后是 2001 年的波士顿丑闻，随后蔓延到整个美国。

sentences.en: And cases are still coming out of the woodwork.
sentences.zh: 而且案件至今仍在不断被揭露。

sentences.en: People are still coming forward for the first time being willing to talk about what happened to them so long ago.
sentences.zh: 人们仍然在第一次站出来，愿意谈论很久以前发生在他们身上的事情。

sentences.en: For a Catholic churchgoer who was abused by a priest, it's very, very hard to come forward.
sentences.zh: 对于一个被神职人员虐待的天主教信徒来说，站出来是非常非常困难的。

sentences.en: It can take a person well into their
sentences.zh: 一个人可能要到

sentences.en: 50s, 60s before they're willing to talk about it.
sentences.zh: 50多岁、60多岁时才愿意谈论它。

sentences.en: And so if it's hard for a lay person, imagine what it would be like for a nun.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果普通信徒都觉得难，想象一下修女会是什么样。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: For Catholics, the nun is often the public giving face of the church.
sentences.zh: 对于天主教徒来说，修女往往是教会的公众形象。

sentences.en: They know nuns as teachers, maybe as healthcare workers, as social workers, sometimes professors.
sentences.zh: 人们眼中的修女是教师、医护人员、社会工作者，有时是教授。

sentences.en: But often the nuns are the
sentences.zh: 但通常修女是

sentences.en: Catholic workers who take care of people.
sentences.zh: 照顾人们的天主教工作者。

sentences.en: But within the church, many nuns tell me they feel like second-class citizens.
sentences.zh: 但在教会内部，许多修女告诉我，她们感觉自己是二等公民。

sentences.en: The priests who are ordained are on top.
sentences.zh: 受过圣职的神职人员处于顶端。

sentences.en: And while the nuns run around and do a lot of the work, and again, are the face of the church to the people, nuns say they often feel subservient to the priests.
sentences.zh: 虽然修女们四处奔波，做了大量工作，再次强调，她们是教会面对民众的形象，但修女们说她们经常感到从属于神职人员。

sentences.en: And in some places, they actually literally are.
sentences.zh: 在某些地方，她们实际上确实如此。

sentences.en: The Vatican's women's magazine, there's a supplement with the Vatican newspaper for women every month, last year came out
sentences.zh: 梵蒂冈的女性杂志，每月有一份随梵蒂冈报纸发行的女性增刊，去年出了一期

sentences.en: with a special edition on work and had an article focused on nuns' work and revealed that nuns are doing menial work for bishops and priests.
sentences.zh: 关于工作的特刊，其中一篇文章聚焦于修女的工作，揭示了修女们正在为神职人员和主教做卑微的工作。

sentences.en: They're doing their laundry, they are cooking their food, and often unpaid and certainly unsung.
sentences.zh: 她们洗衣服、做饭，而且往往没有报酬，当然也默默无闻。

sentences.en: This is not everywhere, but this is common enough across the church.
sentences.zh: 这并非到处如此，但在整个教会中这种情况很普遍。

sentences.en: So while nuns are often highly educated and don't see themselves as subservient, that's often how they are seen by their superiors in the church and by priests.
sentences.zh: 所以，虽然修女们通常受过高等教育，并不认为自己是从属的，但这往往是教会高层和神职人员看待她们的方式。

sentences.en: So might that explain why it's taken so long for us to understand what's been happening to these nuns?
sentences.zh: 那么，这是否能解释为什么我们花了这么久才了解这些修女身上发生的事情？

sentences.en: Because they're essentially subservient.
sentences.zh: 因为她们本质上是从属的。

sentences.en: That's a part of it.
sentences.zh: 这是原因之一。

sentences.en: There are factors that face nuns that don't face lay people who are not living and working in the church.
sentences.zh: 修女面临的因素是那些不在教会生活和工作的普通人所没有的。

sentences.en: For a nun, there's also a fear of retaliation.
sentences.zh: 对于修女来说，还有对报复的恐惧。

sentences.en: If a nun goes and tells her mother superior that she's been abused by the priest, perhaps that's the priest who comes and celebrates mass at their convent every day.
sentences.zh: 如果一名修女去告诉她的院长她被神职人员虐待了，而那个神职人员可能每天都在她们的修道院主持弥撒。

sentences.en: The mother superior might tell the nun, oh, you should just stay quiet.
sentences.zh: 院长可能会告诉修女，哦，你还是保持沉默吧。

sentences.en: We can't risk going public with this.
sentences.zh: 我们冒不起公开此事的风险。

sentences.en: We can't risk a confrontation with this priest or this bishop.
sentences.zh: 我们冒不起与这位神职人员或主教对抗的风险。

sentences.en: So just let it go.
sentences.zh: 所以就这样算了吧。

sentences.en: The other thing that happens in the case of nuns is that in some cultures, they are accused of luring the priest into sex.
sentences.zh: 在修女的案例中，还会发生另一件事，就是在某些文化中，她们被指责引诱神职人员发生性关系。

sentences.en: There's an assumption that, you know, it's the woman who's guilty.
sentences.zh: 有一种假设，你知道，是女性有罪。

sentences.en: It's the woman who caused this.
sentences.zh: 是女性导致了这一切。

sentences.en: So that's also a huge reason why nuns might not come forward and might just sit with this secret for the rest of their lives.
sentences.zh: 所以这也是修女可能不会站出来，并可能在余生中保守这个秘密的一个巨大原因。

sentences.en: But sometimes even when they don't stay quiet, they might report this to their mother superior or a colleague, another nun,
sentences.zh: 但有时即使她们没有保持沉默，她们可能会向院长或同事，另一位修女报告，

sentences.en: who might tell them, you can't go public about this abuse by a priest or by a bishop because they hold the purse strings for our religious order.
sentences.zh: 对方可能会告诉她们，你不能公开神职人员或主教的这种虐待行为，因为他们掌握着我们修会的财政大权。

sentences.en: They could cut us off or they could kick us out of our convent.
sentences.zh: 他们可能会切断我们的资金，或者把我们赶出修道院。

sentences.en: There are some arrangements in some cultures where the women's religious order does not have control of their own finances.
sentences.zh: 在某些文化中，女性修会无法控制自己的财务。

sentences.en: They are at the mercy of these priests and these bishops that we now know, in some cases, were sexually assaulting these nuns.
sentences.zh: 她们受制于这些神职人员和主教，而我们现在知道，在某些情况下，这些人正在性侵这些修女。

sentences.en: Sometimes they are.
sentences.zh: 有时确实如此。

sentences.en: So there's a fear of retaliation, either personally that that nun could be thrown out of her religious order and the life she's always known, or even fear of
sentences.zh: 所以存在对报复的恐惧，要么是个人层面的，那名修女可能被赶出修会，失去她一直熟悉的生活，甚至担心

sentences.en: retaliation against the entire women's religious community, that she could be putting her own sisters in jeopardy.
sentences.zh: 对整个女性修会进行报复，担心她可能会让自己的姐妹们陷入危险。

sentences.en: Do you know cases where nuns try to come forward with accusations and were retaliated against?
sentences.zh: 你知道有修女试图站出来指控却遭到报复的案例吗？

sentences.en: Only recently, last year in Chile, there was an order of nuns where something like half a dozen of the women reported abuse.
sentences.zh: 就在最近，去年在智利，有一个修女会，大约有六名女性报告了虐待行为。

sentences.en: And when they tried to report, they were thrown out of the order.
sentences.zh: 当她们试图报告时，她们被赶出了修会。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Vatican is looking into that case, but the message to those women initially was, we're going to retaliate against you because you spoke out.
sentences.zh: 梵蒂冈正在调查那个案件，但最初给那些女性的信息是，因为你们说了出来，我们要对你们进行报复。

sentences.en: So from everything you're describing, nuns are subservient in the clergy system.
sentences.zh: 所以从你描述的一切来看，修女在神职体系中处于从属地位。

sentences.en: They fear retaliation, and they don't have a lot of outlets to go around the people who are in power.
sentences.zh: 她们害怕报复，而且没有太多渠道绕过当权者。

sentences.en: So that suggests it would be a Herculean task for them to report sexual abuse.
sentences.zh: 这表明她们要报告性侵行为将是一项艰巨的任务。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And nuns are also vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 而且修女也很脆弱。

sentences.en: A lot of them in a lot of cultures other than the United
sentences.zh: 在除美国以外的许多文化中，她们中的许多人

sentences.en: States are very young.
sentences.zh: 非常年轻。

sentences.en: And the same as with lay people, they see the priest as an embodiment of
sentences.zh: 和普通信徒一样，她们将神职人员视为

sentences.en: Jesus.
sentences.zh: 耶稣的化身。

sentences.en: They might see the priest as a father figure.
sentences.zh: 她们可能把神职人员视为父亲形象。

sentences.en: They might also see the priest as their confessor.
sentences.zh: 她们也可能把神职人员视为她们的忏悔神父。

sentences.en: He might be their confessor.
sentences.zh: 他可能是她们的忏悔神父。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: The person to whom they go into a confession booth and describe what their sins are.
